description: Bialy Wilk, a great white wolf of the primeval forest: a huge powerful heavy-built wolf with thick pure snow-white fur with soft pale silver shading, a heavy shaggy white mane on its neck and chest, glowing pale ice-blue eyes, bared white fangs, a big bushy white tail, standing firmly on all four legs in a proud fearless stance with its head held high, noble and fierce, full body, three-quarter view facing right, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole wolf inside the picture, nothing cut off at the edges
